description.value: White Rabbit Coffee Co is a warm, community-oriented coffee shop on Selby Street in Nanaimo, operating next door to the Black Rabbit Kitchen whose team prepares all food from scratch — gluten-free and vegan baked goods alongside rotating seasonal sandwiches and salads. The compact interior offers counter stools, booths, dedicated laptop workstations with outlets, and a dog-friendly patio, making it a welcoming stop whether you're grabbing something to go or settling in. There is no phone; the shop directs all contact through email, giving it a relaxed, no-fuss character that regulars and solo visitors clearly appreciate.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail. Key amenities confirmed directly from website text: Wi-Fi (password available at the counter), device charging (dedicated workstations with plugs built for laptop workers), takeout (explicit 'grab and go' framing), and extensive vegan/GF food options across baked goods, sandwiches, and salads. Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. OSM Sunday closing hour (16:00) conflicts with the website (17:00/5pm), flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM records Sunday closing time as 16:00 but website states 5pm (17:00) — OSM tag may be outdated.
No phone number exists; website explicitly states 'No phone' and directs all contact to email only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating coffee shop with a current website, recent OSM check date (2025-09-14), and no indicators of closure. Useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'most of our baked goods are gluten-free and vegan' and 'there's always a solid mix of gluten-free and vegan options across our sandwiches and salads.'

Device charging.detail: Website FAQ describes 'dedicated workstations with plugs built specifically for solo visitors and laptop workers.'

wow_evidence: dedicated laptop workstations with outlets, Wi-Fi password at the counter
